fullText.simplified:
第2章、赵云

    刘备跑了几天。有一次他掉进了河里，如果不是他的马帮了他，他就死了。后来赵云找到了他，他才安全。
    赵云只有二十多岁，是个年轻人。他以前是北方一个叫公孙的大将军的人，后来公孙大将军被元少杀了，他的军队变成了元少的。赵云不想为元少做事，准备离开北方。
    在离开的路上，赵云遇到了公孙将军以前的好弟弟刘备。刘备和他一样，也是不想为元少做事，准备带关羽和张飞去南方。赵云很喜欢他们，就和他们一起去了南方。
    现在，他们认识已经有十年了。因为最年轻，所以刘备他们对赵云特别好，赵云就像他们最小的弟弟。
    赵云很厉害，有了他的保护，刘备终于回到了新也。
    回到新也的刘备还是像以前一样生活，但他每天都很担心。刘备担心的不是自己的安全，他担心的是自己和弟弟们的明天。他来南方已经十年了，虽然很努力，但这十年里他还是一件大事也没做。穷人还是过得不好，国家也还是老样子，一点儿变化都没有。他想起以前自己说过的“一定要让国家变好”的话，觉得自己真是太没用了，他对自己失望极了！
    刘备一边想，一边在街上慢慢地走着。街上有很多人都认识刘备，有人和他说：“刘大人好！”但刘备一个字也没听进去，他一直想着自己的事。突然，他听到有人在唱歌。
    歌声很特别，刘备认真听了一下，歌儿唱的是：“聪明的人住在山里，他想下山来帮有能力的人做事，但是有能力的人在哪儿呢？”
    刘备很吃惊，想马上找到唱歌的人。
fullText.traditional:
第2章、趙雲

    劉備跑了幾天。有一次他掉進了河裡，如果不是他的馬幫了他，他就死了。後來趙雲找到了他，他才安全。
    趙雲只有二十多歲，是個年輕人。他以前是北方一個叫公孫的大將軍的人，後來公孫大將軍被元少殺了，他的軍隊變成了元少的。趙雲不想為元少做事，準備離開北方。
    在離開的路上，趙雲遇到了公孫將軍以前的好弟弟劉備。劉備和他一樣，也是不想為元少做事，準備帶關羽和張飛去南方。趙雲很喜歡他們，就和他們一起去了南方。
    現在，他們認識已經有十年了。因為最年輕，所以劉備他們對趙雲特別好，趙雲就像他們最小的弟弟。
    趙雲很厲害，有了他的保護，劉備終於回到了新也。
    回到新也的劉備還是像以前一樣生活，但他每天都很擔心。劉備擔心的不是自己的安全，他擔心的是自己和弟弟們的明天。他來南方已經十年了，雖然很努力，但這十年裡他還是一件大事也沒做。窮人還是過得不好，國家也還是老樣子，一點兒變化都沒有。他想起以前自己說過的“一定要讓國家變好”的話，覺得自己真是太沒用了，他對自己失望極了！
    劉備一邊想，一邊在街上慢慢地走著。街上有很多人都認識劉備，有人和他說：“劉大人好！”但劉備一個字也沒聽進去，他一直想著自己的事。突然，他聽到有人在唱歌。
    歌聲很特別，劉備認真聽了一下，歌兒唱的是：“聰明的人住在山裡，他想下山來幫有能力的人做事，但是有能力的人在哪兒呢？”
    劉備很吃驚，想馬上找到唱歌的人。

sentences.english: Liu Bei was on the run for a few days.

sentences.traditional: 有一次他掉進了河裡，如果不是他的馬幫了他，他就死了。後來趙雲找到了他，他才安全。

sentences.english: Once, he fell into a river and would have died had his horse not helped him. He was only safe after Zhao Yun found him.

sentences.simplified: 赵云只有二十多岁，是个年轻人。他以前是北方一个叫公孙的大将军的人，
sentences.traditional: 趙雲只有二十多歲，是個年輕人。他以前是北方一個叫公孫的大將軍的人，
sentences.pinyin: zhào yún zhǐ yǒu èr shí duō suì shì ge nián qīng rén tā yǐ qián shì běi fāng yí ge jiào gōng sūn de dà jiāng jūn de rén
sentences.english: Zhao Yun was a young man, only in his twenties. He used to work for an important general in the north called Gongsun.

sentences.simplified: 后来公孙大将军被元少杀了，他的军队变成了元少的。
sentences.traditional: 後來公孫大將軍被元少殺了，他的軍隊變成了元少的。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái gōng sūn dà jiāng jūn bèi yuán shào shā le tā de jūn duì biàn chéng le yuán shào de
sentences.english: Gongsun was later killed by Yuan Shao, and his troops then belonged to Yuan Shao.

sentences.simplified: 赵云不想为元少做事，准备离开北方。
sentences.traditional: 趙雲不想為元少做事，準備離開北方。
sentences.pinyin: zhào yún bù xiǎng wèi yuán shào zuò shì zhǔn bèi lí kāi běi fāng
sentences.english: Zhao Yun did not want to work for Yuan Shao, so he planned on leaving the north.

sentences.simplified: 在离开的路上，赵云遇到了公孙将军以前的好弟弟刘备。
sentences.traditional: 在離開的路上，趙雲遇到了公孫將軍以前的好弟弟劉備。
sentences.pinyin: zài lí kāi de lù shang zhào yún yù dào le gōng sūn jiāng jūn yǐ qián de hǎo dì di liú bèi
sentences.english: On his way out, Zhao Yun came across General Gongsun’s former “good brother”, Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 刘备和他一样，也是不想为元少做事，准备带关羽和张飞去南方。
sentences.traditional: 劉備和他一樣，也是不想為元少做事，準備帶關羽和張飛去南方。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi hé tā yí yàng yě shì bù xiǎng wèi yuán shào zuò shì zhǔn bèi dài guān yǔ hé zhāng fēi qù nán fāng
sentences.english: Liu Bei, like him, didn’t want to work for Yuan Shao. He planned on heading south, bringing along Guan Yu and Zhang Fei.

sentences.simplified: 赵云很喜欢他们，就和他们一起去了南方。
sentences.traditional: 趙雲很喜歡他們，就和他們一起去了南方。
sentences.pinyin: zhào yún hěn xǐ huan tā men jiù hé tā men yì qǐ qù le nán fāng
sentences.english: Zhao Yun really liked them, so he went south with them.

sentences.simplified: 现在，他们认识已经有十年了。
sentences.traditional: 現在，他們認識已經有十年了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài tā men rèn shi yǐ jīng yǒu shí nián le
sentences.english: They had now already known each other for ten years.

sentences.simplified: 因为最年轻，所以刘备他们对赵云特别好，赵云就像他们最小的弟弟。
sentences.traditional: 因為最年輕，所以劉備他們對趙雲特別好，趙雲就像他們最小的弟弟。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zuì nián qīng suǒ yǐ liú bèi tā men duì zhào yún tè bié hǎo zhào yún jiù xiàng tā men zuì xiǎo de dì di
sentences.english: Because he was the youngest, Liu Bei and the others were very good to Zhao Yun. Zhao Yun was like their youngest brother.

sentences.simplified: 赵云很厉害，有了他的保护，刘备终于回到了新也。
sentences.traditional: 趙雲很厲害，有了他的保護，劉備終於回到了新也。
sentences.pinyin: zhào yún hěn lì hai yǒu le tā de bǎo hù liú bèi zhōng yú huí dào le xīn yě
sentences.english: Zhao Yun was very formidable, and with his protection, Liu Bei finally returned to Xinye.

sentences.simplified: 回到新也的刘备还是像以前一样生活，但他每天都很担心。
sentences.traditional: 回到新也的劉備還是像以前一樣生活，但他每天都很擔心。
sentences.pinyin: huí dào xīn yě de liú bèi hái shi xiàng yǐ qián yí yàng shēng huó dàn tā měi tiān dōu hěn dān xīn
sentences.english: After returning to Xinye, Liu Bei lived as he had before, but he was very worried every day.

sentences.simplified: 刘备担心的不是自己的安全，他担心的是自己和弟弟们的明天。
sentences.traditional: 劉備擔心的不是自己的安全，他擔心的是自己和弟弟們的明天。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi dān xīn de bú shì zì jǐ de ān quán tā dān xīn de shì zì jǐ hé dì di men de míng tiān
sentences.english: What Liu Bei worried about was not his safety. He was worried about his and his younger brothers’ future.

sentences.simplified: 他来南方已经十年了，虽然很努力，但这十年里他还是一件大事也没做。
sentences.traditional: 他來南方已經十年了，雖然很努力，但這十年裡他還是一件大事也沒做。
sentences.pinyin: tā lái nán fāng yǐ jīng shí nián le suī rán hěn nǔ lì dàn zhè shí nián lǐ tā hái shi yí jiàn dà shì yě méi zuò
sentences.english: He had already been in the south for ten years, and though he worked very hard, he had not done any great deed in these ten years.

sentences.simplified: 穷人还是过得不好，国家也还是老样子，一点儿变化都没有。
sentences.traditional: 窮人還是過得不好，國家也還是老樣子，一點兒變化都沒有。
sentences.pinyin: qióng rén hái shi guò de bù hǎo guó jiā yě hái shi lǎo yàng zi yì diǎn'r biàn huà dōu méi yǒu
sentences.english: The poor were still not doing well, and the country was still the same. Nothing had changed at all.

sentences.simplified: 他想起以前自己说过的“一定要让国家变好”的话，
sentences.traditional: 他想起以前自己說過的“一定要讓國家變好”的話，

sentences.english: He remembered what he had said before: “I must make this country better.”

sentences.traditional: 覺得自己真是太沒用了，他對自己失望極了！

sentence_translations: Chapter 2: Zhao Yun
Liu Bei was on the run for a few days.
Once, he fell into a river and would have died had his horse not helped him. He was only safe after Zhao Yun found him.
Zhao Yun was a young man, only in his twenties. He used to work for an important general in the north called Gongsun.
Gongsun was later killed by Yuan Shao, and his troops then belonged to Yuan Shao.
Zhao Yun did not want to work for Yuan Shao, so he planned on leaving the north.
On his way out, Zhao Yun came across General Gongsun’s former “good brother”, Liu Bei.
Liu Bei, like him, didn’t want to work for Yuan Shao. He planned on heading south, bringing along Guan Yu and Zhang Fei.
Zhao Yun really liked them, so he went south with them.
They had now already known each other for ten years.
Because he was the youngest, Liu Bei and the others were very good to Zhao Yun. Zhao Yun was like their youngest brother.
Zhao Yun was very formidable, and with his protection, Liu Bei finally returned to Xinye.
After returning to Xinye, Liu Bei lived as he had before, but he was very worried every day.
What Liu Bei worried about was not his safety. He was worried about his and his younger brothers’ future.
He had already been in the south for ten years, and though he worked very hard, he had not done any great deed in these ten years.
The poor were still not doing well, and the country was still the same. Nothing had changed at all.
He remembered what he had said before: “I must make this country better.”
He felt so useless. He was extremely disappointed in himself!
Liu Bei Liu Bei thought about this as he walked slowly down the street.
There were many people who knew Liu Bei on the street. Someone said to him, “Hello, Lord Liu!”
But Liu Bei did not hear a word. He was thinking his own thoughts. Suddenly, he heard someone singing.
The voice was very special. Liu Bei listened carefully for a while.
The song went: “The intelligent man lives on a mountain. He wants to come down and help the capable man accomplish things, ..
.. but where is the capable man?”
Liu Bei Liu Bei was taken aback. He wanted to immediately find the person singing the song.
